Sean —

So sorry about this morning. We had an incident with a production ingest job that took the on-call team through the window — completely my fault for not cancelling.

We definitely want to move forward. Given the internal stakeholders that need to be in the room, can we split this into two focused sessions:

1) Usage & Ops deep-dive (technical) — attendance: our Infra lead (Tom), our SREs, and Monica from your side. Goal: per-tenant patterns, anomaly sources, caching opportunities.
2) Commercial & Forecast (executive) — attendance: me + VP of Data, Marissa and Sean. Goal: capacity forecast, pricing model for a multi-region rollout, timing for expansion.

Proposed windows next week (all PT):
- Mon, Feb 28 — 10:00–10:45 (ops deep-dive)
- Tue, Mar 1 — 11:00–11:45 (commercial & forecast)

If those don't work we can shift by a day. Also appreciate the docs you shared — I skimmed the usage brief and will ask Tom to pull logs that might affect the forecast.

Apologies again for the no-show. Looking forward to the split sessions — this format should be better for our stakeholders.

Best regards,
